title: LightsOn - Motivational workout tracker that lets you power a city
author: Jero9871
selftext:
Hey all,

I make a small mobile game called LightsOn (iPhone, Apple Watch and Android). The idea is simple: your active calories from Apple Health or Health Connect charge the battery of a little isometric city. If you keep moving, the lights stay on and people move in. If you stop, the battery runs dry, the city goes dark and residents start leaving. On top of that there's a factory that makes Gears, which you spend on upgrades, new districts, monuments and so on.

The early versions were mostly made the old-fashioned way. AI was mainly used to track bugs. Then I started improving my hand drawn vector arts with AI which was a blast.

For version 3 I wanted something I'd been putting off for ages: tapping a house and looking inside. Every home gets its own rooms, furniture you can buy and recolor, residents walking around, even pets. Later the town hall, the factory and the city battery got interiors too. Doing all that alone would have taken me forever, so this is where I started using AI properly.

The part I didn't expect: the hard bit wasn't getting stuff made, it was getting it to fit. The game already had a look, and new things had to blend in with it. So most of my time went into reviewing, saying "no, that sofa looks off", and going back and forth until it matched what was already there. Some rounds took a while. But it got the feature out the door in a fraction of the time it would have taken me, and there are now 160+ pieces of furniture in there. With different styles its over 1000 pieces. 

The trailer shows the whole game, with the interiors in the middle part.

Now interesting part I was able to get everything down to 4MB on Android, which was pretty crazy how much AI can improve. Another interesting thing is, I use no game engine at all, just drawing on canvas and SpriteKit on iOS.

The game has now thousands of active players and pretty good ratings on the stores.

Things I care about:

\- Completely free

\- No ads

\- No in-app purchases

\- No account, no tracking, your health data stays on your device

Happy to answer questions about the AI part, the health integration, or anything else. Feedback is very welcome too, especially from people who've mixed handmade and AI-assisted work in one project.

comments.author: Jero9871
comments.body: Regarding which AI I used, for the interiors mostly Opus 5.5. But I had to review many things with Astra 6.
